candidate_windows.window_text: Our experiments are conducted using off-the-shelf LLM models. We employ the Together.AI $^6$ API for inference with Gemma-2 7B, Mistral 7B Instruct, Mixtral $8 \times 7$ B Instruct, LLaMA-3 8B Instruct, and LLaMA-3 70B Instruct. For GPT-4 Turbo, we utilize OpenAI's official API $^7$ .
